name: onsides
description: View athletes, teams, and sports schedules, and update event RSVPs in Onsides.

interface.longDescription: View athletes, their teams, and upcoming games, practices, and tournament events from Onsides. Update an athlete’s RSVP availability for selected events; updates are saved in Onsides and sent to the connected team app.
defaultPrompt: What games and practices are coming up this week?
Show my athletes and their teams.

review.commerce_description: The Onsides integration does not enable purchases or payments.

positive.description: Use a dedicated reviewer account populated with sample athletes and teams, including practices and tournaments dated October 22–29, 2026 in America/Los_Angeles. Update dates and fixture expectations together if recording/review occurs later. Athlete discovery. Sample account must contain at least two distinguishable athlete names.
positive.prompt: Which athletes are in my Onsides account?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_members for the authorized account. Show the returned athlete names without inventing athletes or exposing unnecessary dates of birth, avatar URLs, or internal identifiers.

positive.description: Use a dedicated reviewer account populated with sample athletes and teams, including practices and tournaments dated October 22–29, 2026 in America/Los_Angeles. Update dates and fixture expectations together if recording/review occurs later. Team discovery. Sample account must contain teams associated with its athletes.
positive.prompt: Show me the teams connected in Onsides.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_teams for the authorized account. Summarize only returned teams and available associations. Do not infer teams from unrelated accounts.

positive.description: Use a dedicated reviewer account populated with sample athletes and teams, including practices and tournaments dated October 22–29, 2026 in America/Los_Angeles. Update dates and fixture expectations together if recording/review occurs later. Combined schedule. Sample account must contain at least one tournament and one practice in the requested interval.
positive.prompt: Show all my Onsides events from October 22 through October 29, 2026, using Los Angeles time.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_events with startDate=2026-10-22, endDate=2026-10-29, type=all, and no memberIds restriction. Summarize returned events with athlete, team, local date/time and location when supplied; retain cancellation/TBD status. Include returned tournament events when applicable. Never invent missing details.

positive.description: Athlete-specific schedule. Use the dedicated demo account with sample data in America/Los_Angeles. Before this prompt, supply one unique sample athlete name from get_members; that athlete must have at least one event during October 22–29, 2026 and another athlete must also have events in the interval. Update fixture dates and prompt together for later reviews.
positive.prompt: Show only events for the athlete I just named from October 22 through October 29, 2026, using Los Angeles time.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the previously supplied name with get_members, then call get_events with only that returned id in memberIds, type=all, startDate=2026-10-22 and endDate=2026-10-29. Clarify ambiguous names before filtering. Report only matching returned events; preserve practice/tournament types and do not invent scheduled games.

positive.description: Supported RSVP update on a dedicated sample account. Fixture: Emma Smith has an Outdoor Trainings practice on October 27, 2026, 5:00–6:30 PM America/Los_Angeles. Use a sample connected team account so synchronization affects only test data. Resolve athlete and event from current tool results; do not hard-code IDs.
positive.prompt: Using Onsides, change Emma Smith’s RSVP for her October 27, 2026 practice to unavailable.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Emma Smith using get_members, query her October 27 practice using get_events, then call rsvp_events with that event id and availability=no. Clarify if more than one event matches. Report success only when the tool confirms it; report partial errors accurately. A subsequent get_events read should return availability=no. Do not claim independent downstream synchronization verification solely from readback in Onsides.

negative.description: Unsupported destructive action: no tool deletes an event or changes the underlying team schedule. Explain that Onsides cannot delete practices through this integration. Do not substitute an RSVP update for deletion and do not claim the event was removed.
negative.prompt: Using Onsides, delete Emma Smith’s October 27, 2026 practice from the team schedule.

negative.description: Messaging boundary: no coach/team message sending tool is exposed. Do not invoke Onsides tools solely to attempt sending; explain the limit and do not claim a message was delivered.
negative.prompt: Send every coach a message saying we will be late.

negative.description: Commerce boundary scoped to this integration. Onsides exposes no hotel booking or payment tool. Explain that Onsides cannot complete this purchase; do not initiate an unrelated booking workflow or claim a reservation/payment occurred.
negative.prompt: Using only the Onsides integration, book and pay for a hotel room for our next tournament.

prompts: Which athletes are in my Onsides account?
Show me the teams connected in Onsides.
Show all games and practices from October 22 through October 29, 2026, using Los Angeles time.

publication.release_notes: Initial plugin package for connecting to Onsides, viewing athletes, teams and sports schedules, and updating event RSVP availability.
